description: This file defines the 'Features' interface, which represents a collection of a Thing's Features in an immutable, JSON-serializable manner. It provides methods for creating, modifying, and retrieving features and their related data within the context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing an immutable Features instance.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with the current Features instance for further modifications.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Retrieves a Feature by its ID, if present.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Sets or replaces a Feature in the collection, returning a new Features instance.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Removes a Feature by its ID, returning a new Features instance.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets the definition for a specific Feature by its ID.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the feature definition for a given Feature ID.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets properties for a specific Feature.

methods.name: removeProperties
methods.description: Removes all properties from a Feature.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific property value within a Feature, referenced by a JsonPointer.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Removes a property from a Feature by JsonPointer reference.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of Features contained.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the Features collection is empty.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a Stream of the contained Feature objects.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Features collection into a JsonObject.

methods.name: toJson (overload)
methods.description: Serializes the Features collection into a JsonObject with specified schema version and field selector.
